This app requires WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission to function properly.

To grant this permission, connect your device to a computer and run the following ADB command:

adb shell pm grant com.duck.stayawakeadb android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

This command cannot be executed from the device itself.
